purpose: Teach: 壷/林道/極楽/大昔/甘み/グリル/シェイクスピア/大黒

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店に陶器の壷を飾りたいわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I've been thinking — wouldn't it be nice to put a ceramic piece in the shop? Something handmade.
lines.style: Gentle, musing tone. Soft opening, like she's been turning the idea over in her mind. Warm and unhurried, inviting Aoi into the thought rather than proposing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、林道をハイキングされたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our customers mentioned they went hiking on that forest trail last week. It sounded beautiful.
lines.style: Observant, connecting-the-dots cadence. Small smile in the voice — noticing and sharing something that landed with a customer. Conversational, not announcing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニュー、極楽の味だって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer told me the new menu tastes like paradise. That's exactly what we were going for.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Light emphasis on the word paradise — savoring it. Not self-satisfied, but genuinely pleased that the intention came through.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、大昔のお店の写真を持ってこられたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Someone brought in old photographs of the shop from way back. The place was so different then.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic. Moderate pace, letting the image settle. Curious underneath — wondering what changed, what stayed the same.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ハチミツの甘みを生かしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: For the new menu, let's make sure the honey's sweetness really shines through. That's the heart of it.
lines.style: Decisive but not abrupt. Clear directional pull on the word honey. Warm still — guiding rather than commanding. Confident in the vision.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店にグリルキッチンを増設したいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, we could really use a grill station in the kitchen. It would open up so much.
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, almost wondering aloud. Warm opening, slight lift of possibility on grill. Not urgent, but genuine — imagining it as she speaks.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シェイクスピアの劇を観られたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of our regulars went to see a Shakespeare play. They came back talking about it for days.
lines.style: Genuine delight in the memory. Moderate, easy pace. The happiness of watching someone light up over something beautiful. Understated warmth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご実家に大黒柱の家を建てられたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned they built a beautiful house back in their hometown. There was such pride in how they said it.
lines.style: Reflective, tender. Soft pace, lingering on the idea of home and accomplishment. Not gossipy — genuinely moved by the person's quiet joy. Trail off gently.
